profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Walmart.
profile.summary:
•       Experience in software development/design that including Java, JSPs and Servlet Technologies..
•	Specialization in Design and Development of Multi-Tier architecture and web based systems.
•	Experience in Enterprise Distributed Systems programming.
•	Excellent analytical, problem solving skills
•	Sound experience of Client Interaction, communication and presentation skills.
•	Good exposure to quality processes which conforms to level 5 of SEI-CMM.

Specialties: •	Programming Languages:  Java, J2EE, C
•	Scripting Languages:  Java Script, jQuery
•	Web Technologies:  HTML, DHTML, XML, CSS, AJAX, SVG, XSLT, XPath
•	Middleware: CORBA, RMI, JMS(JBOSSMq), Web Services(SOAP)
•	Server Side technologies:  PHP, JSP
•	Frameworks:  MVC
•	App Servers & Web Servers: Weblogic, Tomcat, Websphere
•	Platforms: Windows, Linux
•	Databases: Oracle 9i,10g, MySQL
•	Tools:  Eclipse, VSS, USD

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Facebook Integration:
- Developed an application to surface Merchandising recommendations on Facebook.
- Customized recommendation tool for the purpose of integration.
- Worked on PHP, JavaScript, Ajax, CSS for developing the application.

•	Developed a utility for synchronizing Hudson with Clearcase using Java.
•	Fixed failed JUnit test cases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
This project dealt with the Production Support of PLM implementation for manufacturing giant.

•	Optimized software development process for Production Support through code tuning and refactoring.
•	Responsible for design, development and code review of Change Requests from Client.
•	Responsible for code deployment on Development, QA and Production Server.
•	Imparted training to end users on core Java, JSPs, Dassault’s Enovia and Java Programming Objects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
This project automated the lifecycle of Product Specification for Consumer Package Goods Company (Fortune 500) using Enovia's Framework and Specification Central.

•	Developed Java Programming Objects according to functional specifications.
•	Designed Data Models using UML.
•	Generated Schema using Matrix Query Language, TCL Scripts and Spinner (XLS based Database).
•	Developed and modified web pages using JSP, HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
This project standardized and rationalized different engineering processes for a Manufacturing Company (Fortune 500).

•	Developed new modules using customization, configuration and extension for Engineering Data Management using Java based framework.
•	Developed the utility for the data transfer from PLM to BaaN ERP and vice versa, using Java programming objects for business logic and XML for data storage and transfer.
•	Performed Unit Testing (JUnit), Integration and System testing.
•	Prepared proof of concepts using existing Enovia framework and Microsoft PowerPoint during Requirement Analysis phase.

positions.title: Software Engineer Trainee
positions.description:
This project developed a new module, Technical Purchase Managing System (TPMS) for a technology based corporation.

•	Developed dashboards for different modules for Data Analysis using Java and JSPs.
•	Responsible for fixing post delivery bugs.
•	Documented the user manual for the project.

courses.name: Enterprise Distributed Systems, Theory of Computation, Web Technologies

honors.title: Star Rookie Award
honors.description: Jumped into most complex vehicles platform and made significant contributions from quality standpoint.
honors.issuer: Issued by Daniel Fain, VP of Engineering · Dec 2016
